provenance.creator: Economics & Finance Mastery Library
provenance.kind: Original synthetic teaching fixture; no observed economic series
provenance.access: Supplied with this chapter, no credentials or external download required
provenance.reuse: This original synthetic fixture and its companion laboratory code may be used, modified and redistributed for teaching and research with attribution to this library; no third-party data are included.
provenance.case_assumptions: A single synthetic economy, monthly spending flows, no seasonal adjustment, common fixed base-price index; each row jointly releases spending and index at the end of its availability date. Revision dates are invented.

dictionary.period: Reference calendar month, YYYY-MM; monthly flow rather than annualized rate or stock
dictionary.available_on: Inclusive information-availability date, YYYY-MM-DD; cutoff means after the day's release. No intraday timing is modeled.
dictionary.nominal_spending: Nonnegative integer dollars spent in the reference month at current prices, no thousands multiplier
dictionary.price_index: Positive integer index on a common fixed price base equal to 100; real spending = 100 * nominal_spending / price_index
dictionary.key: The pair (period, available_on) uniquely identifies one joint vintage observation; period alone is not a key in the release history.
dictionary.missing: No missing fields allowed in this small case; an unavailable required month rejects the requested complete-quarter summary.
